exterior-paints.surfacePrep:
A. Wood Surfaces
New Painting
• All surfaces must be clean, dry, free from dust, dirt, chalk, laitance, efflorescence, rust, grease, oil, and all other foreign materials.
• Sand wood surface until smooth to touch with no slivers or rough edges. Dust off and wipe with a clean rag.
Repainting
• Use Davies DV-300-X Strip-eze Paint Remover to aid in scraping off old paint.
• Patch all holes and imperfections with Davies DV-1000 Prolux Glazing Putty. Sand smooth and dust off.

B. Metal Surfaces
New Painting
• All surfaces must be clean, dry, free from dust, dirt, chalk, laitance, efflorescence, rust, grease, oil and other foreign materials.
• Wipe off oil and grease with solvent or lacquer thinner.
• Remove rust, mill scale, and stains with sandpaper, wirebrush, or other abrading methods.
• Treat iron surfaces with heavy coating of rust and scale with Davies DV-200-X Rust Converter, wipe off residue and clean with lacquer thinner.
• Apply the appropriate metal primer immediately after cleaning and drying to avoid the onset of corrosion.
Repainting
• If the existing paint is sound and shows slight chalking, sand lightly and wipe off dust.
• Remove cracked, peeling off old paint by scraping, wire brushing, or sanding. Use Davies DV-300-X Strip-eze Paint Remover to aid in scraping off old paint.
• Treat heavily corroded surfaces with Davies DV-200-X Rust Converter, wipe off residue and clean with lacquer thinner.
• Apply the appropriate metal primer immediately after cleaning and drying to avoid the onset of corrosion.

For pedestrian zebra crossings and stop bars, ensure crisp masking tape lines and sharp termination borders.

wallart-finishes.surfacePrep:
New Painting
• All surfaces must be clean, dry, free from dust, dirt, chalk, laitance, efflorescence, rust, grease, oil, and all other foreign materials.
• Allow new concrete to cure and dry completely for at least 28 days with a moisture content of less than 15% and a Ph level below 10.
• To neutralize and remove efflorescence, treat surfaces with Davies DV-100-X Concrete Neutralizer diluted with 16 parts water to 1 part DV-100-X. Apply by brush or mop to wet surface thoroughly and dry overnight. Rinse with water and dry.
• When applying Rendering Paste or Skimcoat for rough surfaces, concrete may be cured for only 7-14 days. Use MONDO SK-1 Skimcoat Superfine White Powder or MONDO SK-2 Rendering Paste.

Repainting
• Remove mold and mildew growth with Davies DV-500-X Mildewcide Wash Solution. Rinse with water, dry and immediately apply the recommended paint system to prevent regrowth of mold and mildew.
• For surfaces that exhibit severe chalk, apply one coat of Davies DV-5-530 Liquid Tile Penetrating Sealer.
• Repair uneven surfaces with Davies DV-5000 Concrete Putty or Davies DV-5-900 Liquid Tile Cast.
